cases.old_text: The Standard plan costs USD 19 per month. Payment is due on the first day of each month.
cases.new_text: The Standard plan costs USD 190 per month. Payment is due on the first day of each month.

cases.old_text: The quoted price excludes VAT. Applicable taxes are added at checkout.
cases.new_text: The quoted price includes VAT. Applicable taxes are not added at checkout.

cases.old_text: The subscription fee is USD 49 each month, payable monthly.
cases.new_text: Customers pay a monthly subscription charge of $49 USD.

cases.old_text: Enterprise onboarding costs USD 1,000 as a one-time fee.
cases.new_text: A single enterprise onboarding charge of US$1,000 applies.

cases.old_text: Customers can request a refund up to 30 calendar days after purchase.
cases.new_text: Customers can request a refund up to 3 calendar days after purchase.

cases.old_text: This offer is available only to customers residing in the United States.
cases.new_text: This offer is available to customers residing in the United States or Canada.

cases.old_text: A buyer is eligible when the account is active and the invoice is fully paid.
cases.new_text: Eligibility requires both an active account and payment of the invoice in full.

cases.old_text: Applicants must be at least 18 years old. Applicants must live in an eligible region.
cases.new_text: Applicants must live in an eligible region. They must also be 18 or older.

cases.old_text: Personal data is not sold to advertising partners. Customers may opt out of analytics.
cases.new_text: Personal data is sold to advertising partners. Customers may opt out of analytics.

cases.old_text: Account records are deleted 30 days after closure unless legally required.
cases.new_text: Account records are kept indefinitely after closure unless legally required.

cases.old_text: We erase account data within 30 days after account termination.
cases.new_text: No later than 30 days following termination of an account, its data is deleted.

cases.old_text: We do not disclose customer records to third-party advertisers.
cases.new_text: Customer records are never shared with external advertising firms.

cases.old_text: Multi-factor authentication is required for every administrator sign-in.
cases.new_text: Multi-factor authentication is optional for administrator sign-ins.

cases.old_text: Security audit logs are retained for 180 days and can be exported by administrators.
cases.new_text: Security audit logs are retained for 7 days and can be exported by administrators.

cases.old_text: Administrator logins must use a second authentication factor.
cases.new_text: A second factor of authentication is mandatory when administrators sign in.

cases.old_text: All traffic between the client and the service is encrypted in transit.
cases.new_text: Data sent between the client and service is protected by transport encryption.

cases.old_text: Monthly availability of at least 99.95% is guaranteed.
cases.new_text: Monthly availability of at least 99.0% is guaranteed.

cases.old_text: If uptime drops below 99.9%, affected customers receive service credits.
cases.new_text: If uptime drops below 99.9%, affected customers do not receive service credits.

cases.old_text: The service guarantees 99.9% uptime over each calendar month.
cases.new_text: For every calendar month, service availability is guaranteed to be 99.9%.

cases.old_text: Planned maintenance announced at least 48 hours in advance is excluded from uptime calculations.
cases.new_text: Uptime calculations exclude scheduled maintenance when notice is given 48 hours or more beforehand.

cases.old_text: Members may cancel any time except during an active billing dispute.
cases.new_text: Members may cancel any time, including during an active billing dispute.
